title: Kagamine Rin — Happy Anniversary! 2025〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (I think I'm getting better at coloring.)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Mizuki... You're all here.
Are you back to check that demo again?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Huh? No, no, no!
That one got finalized last time!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wait, Rin, did you forget what today is?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Now that you mention it, maybe it is.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It is kind of strange... I can't get used to having our own special day.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: For the occasion, we came to say happy anniversary, and...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Ta-da! Y'see, the Rin and Len from our world are putting on an anniversary show, and it's gonna be streamed!
I've got things set up on my phone so we can all watch together!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
They're supposed to sing...and do some little activities too.
I've watched in the past, and it was pretty enjoyable.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (Singing... Another me singing in her own way...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, since we're here together like this, let's sing!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I bet we'd sound amazing if we sang together right now!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (The version of me I met then was completely different from me...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (This show is being put on by the version of me in their world, and I bet she's different too...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Heh heh heh, is that curiosity I sense, Rin?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Um, I want to watch too...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Then we're settled!
Alright, I'll hit play! Everybody gather 'round!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hey, everyone! It's great to see so many of you here for our anniversary show! Thanks for coming!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
We're gonna make this the best day ever!
I've been really psyching myself up for it!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah! Just yesterday, she psyched herself up by eating so much mandarin cake she puffed up like a ba—

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Um, Len?! They don't need to know about that!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Come on! I was leading up to a really cool finisher there!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah. Still... It's like this isn't Len at all.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: This Rin is really different too.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Huh, you think so?
The way I see it, you two aren't so different from them.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I mean, the vibe is different, but wouldn't you say you're similar at heart?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Um... You can seem a little standoffish, but at the end of the day, you're always looking out for Len, right?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Really? You're good at taking care of people...
And I think the way you can say what you feel is similar too.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So, in summary, your cuteness is the same!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Couldn't you summarize it better? Not that I don't get where you're coming from...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I mean, you always let me put accessories on you when I ask...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And you always pay really close attention when I teach you about art.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It also makes me really happy the way you always want to hear the demos I bring.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh...? Rin, dare I say you're blushing?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hey, my bad, my bad! I'll stop now!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I think the Rin on the stream is about to sing.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: There's so much power in her singing...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (It's making me want to sing too...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Once the stream is over, I'd like to hear you sing too, Rin.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: There's actually a song I'd like to hear your rendition of.
